mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO ${databaseCode.toLowerCase()}_publication(pmid,pub_year,journal_title,title,abstract_text,affiliation_info, keyword_list,doi,source_url,authors_json,mesh_headings_json,grants_json,cncb_banks_json,raw_payload, is_primary,is_related,relation_status,source_hash,fetched_at) VALUES
(#{r.pmid},#{r.pubYear},#{r.journalTitle},#{r.title},#{r.abstractText},#{r.affiliationInfo}, #{r.keywordList},#{r.doi},#{r.sourceUrl},#{r.authorsJson},#{r.meshHeadingsJson},#{r.grantsJson},#{r.cncbBanksJson},#{r.rawPayload}, 0,#{r.related},'PENDING',#{r.sourceHash},NOW())
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE is_related=GREATEST(is_related,VALUES(is_related)), relation_status=IF(NOT(source_hash<=>VALUES(source_hash)),'PENDING',relation_status), pub_year=IF(NOT(source_hash<=>VALUES(source_hash)),VALUES(pub_year),pub_year), journal_title=IF(NOT(source_hash<=>VALUES(source_hash)),VALUES(journal_title),journal_title), doi=IF(NOT(source_hash<=>VALUES(source_hash)),VALUES(doi),doi), title=IF(NOT(source_hash<=>VALUES(source_hash)),VALUES(title),title), abstract_text=IF(NOT(source_hash<=>VALUES(source_hash)),VALUES(abstract_text),abstract_text), source_url=IF(NOT(source_hash<=>VALUES(source_hash)),VALUES(source_url),source_url), affiliation_info=IF(NOT(source_hash<=>VALUES(source_hash)),VALUES(affiliation_info),affiliation_info), keyword_list=IF(NOT(source_hash<=>VALUES(source_hash)),VALUES(keyword_list),keyword_list), authors_json=IF(NOT(source_hash<=>VALUES(source_hash)),VALUES(authors_json),authors_json), mesh_headings_json=IF(NOT(source_hash<=>VALUES(source_hash)),VALUES(mesh_headings_json),mesh_headings_json), grants_json=IF(NOT(source_hash<=>VALUES(source_hash)),VALUES(grants_json),grants_json), cncb_banks_json=IF(NOT(source_hash<=>VALUES(source_hash)),VALUES(cncb_banks_json),cncb_banks_json), raw_payload=IF(NOT(source_hash<=>VALUES(source_hash)),VALUES(raw_payload),raw_payload), source_hash=VALUES(source_hash)

INSERT INTO genbase_publication(paper_id,pmid,doi,paper_title,publish_year,journal_name,source_url,raw_payload, openlb_status,abstract_text,affiliation_info,keyword_list,authors_json,mesh_headings_json, grants_json,cncb_banks_json,openlb_raw_payload,is_primary,is_related,relation_status,source_hash,fetched_at) VALUES
(NULL,#{r.pmid},#{r.doi},COALESCE(#{r.title},CONCAT('PMID ',#{r.pmid})),#{r.pubYear},#{r.journalTitle},#{r.sourceUrl},CAST(#{r.rawPayload} AS JSON), 'SUCCESS',#{r.abstractText},#{r.affiliationInfo},#{r.keywordList},#{r.authorsJson},#{r.meshHeadingsJson}, #{r.grantsJson},#{r.cncbBanksJson},#{r.rawPayload},0,#{r.related},'PENDING',#{r.sourceHash},NOW())
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE is_related=GREATEST(is_related,VALUES(is_related)), relation_status=IF(NOT(source_hash<=>VALUES(source_hash)),'PENDING',relation_status), paper_title=IF(NOT(source_hash<=>VALUES(source_hash)),VALUES(paper_title),paper_title), abstract_text=IF(NOT(source_hash<=>VALUES(source_hash)),VALUES(abstract_text),abstract_text), affiliation_info=IF(NOT(source_hash<=>VALUES(source_hash)),VALUES(affiliation_info),affiliation_info), keyword_list=IF(NOT(source_hash<=>VALUES(source_hash)),VALUES(keyword_list),keyword_list), authors_json=IF(NOT(source_hash<=>VALUES(source_hash)),VALUES(authors_json),authors_json), mesh_headings_json=IF(NOT(source_hash<=>VALUES(source_hash)),VALUES(mesh_headings_json),mesh_headings_json), grants_json=IF(NOT(source_hash<=>VALUES(source_hash)),VALUES(grants_json),grants_json), cncb_banks_json=IF(NOT(source_hash<=>VALUES(source_hash)),VALUES(cncb_banks_json),cncb_banks_json), openlb_raw_payload=IF(NOT(source_hash<=>VALUES(source_hash)),VALUES(openlb_raw_payload),openlb_raw_payload), source_hash=VALUES(source_hash)

INSERT INTO research_publication_relation(database_code,left_identifier_type,left_identifier, right_identifier_type,right_identifier,relation_type,evidence_url,discovery_depth,active,last_seen_run_id,last_seen_time) VALUES(#{databaseCode},#{leftType},#{leftValue},#{rightType},#{rightValue},'RELATED_PUBLICATION',#{evidenceUrl},#{depth},1,#{jobId},NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE active=1,evidence_url=COALESCE(VALUES(evidence_url),evidence_url), discovery_depth=LEAST(discovery_depth,VALUES(discovery_depth)),last_seen_run_id=VALUES(last_seen_run_id),last_seen_time=NOW()
mapper.update: UPDATE research_publication_relation SET active=0,update_time=NOW() WHERE database_code=#{databaseCode} AND relation_type='RELATED_PUBLICATION' AND ((left_identifier_type=#{identifierType} AND left_identifier=#{identifier}) OR (right_identifier_type=#{identifierType} AND right_identifier=#{identifier})) AND (last_seen_run_id IS NULL OR last_seen_run_id<>#{jobId})

choose.when: UPDATE bioproject_publication SET relation_status=#{status},relation_last_error=#{error},relation_attempt_count=relation_attempt_count+IF(#{status}='RUNNING',1,0),relation_checked_at=IF(#{status}='COMPLETED',NOW(),relation_checked_at),update_time=NOW() WHERE (#{identifierType}='PMID' AND pmid=#{identifier}) OR (#{identifierType}='DOI' AND doi=#{identifier}) OR (#{identifierType}='SOURCE_KEY' AND bioproject_record_key=#{identifier})

UPDATE gsa_publication SET relation_status=#{status},relation_last_error=#{error},relation_attempt_count=relation_attempt_count+IF(#{status}='RUNNING',1,0),relation_checked_at=IF(#{status}='COMPLETED',NOW(),relation_checked_at),update_time=NOW() WHERE (#{identifierType}='PMID' AND pmid=#{identifier}) OR (#{identifierType}='DOI' AND doi=#{identifier}) OR (#{identifierType}='SOURCE_KEY' AND gsa_record_key=#{identifier})
choose.otherwise: UPDATE genbase_publication SET relation_status=#{status},relation_last_error=#{error}, relation_attempt_count=relation_attempt_count+IF(#{status}='RUNNING',1,0), relation_checked_at=IF(#{status}='COMPLETED',NOW(),relation_checked_at),update_time=NOW() WHERE (#{identifierType}='PAPER_ID' AND paper_id=CAST(#{identifier} AS UNSIGNED)) OR (#{identifierType}='PMID' AND pmid=#{identifier}) OR (#{identifierType}='DOI' AND doi=#{identifier})

mapper.update: UPDATE research_relation_crawl_job SET status=#{status},last_error=#{error}, completed_time=IF(#{status} IN ('SUCCESS','FAILED','STOPPED'),NOW(),NULL),update_time=NOW() WHERE id=#{jobId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM research_publication_relation WHERE database_code=#{databaseCode} AND active=1 AND relation_type='RELATED_PUBLICATION' AND ((left_identifier_type=#{identifierType} AND left_identifier=#{identifier}) OR (right_identifier_type=#{identifierType} AND right_identifier=#{identifier}))

SELECT r.id relation_id, CASE WHEN r.left_identifier_type=#{identifierType} AND r.left_identifier=#{identifier} THEN r.right_identifier_type ELSE r.left_identifier_type END identifier_type, CASE WHEN r.left_identifier_type=#{identifierType} AND r.left_identifier=#{identifier} THEN r.right_identifier ELSE r.left_identifier END identifier_value, p.pmid,p.doi,p.title,p.pub_year,r.evidence_url,r.discovery_depth,r.active,p.source_url,p.gsa_accessions,p.bioproject_accession,p.cncb_banks_json,'PUBLICATION' record_kind,NULL resource_accession,NULL resource_url FROM research_publication_relation r LEFT JOIN
(SELECT pmid,doi,title,pub_year,bioproject_record_key gsa_record_key,source_url,NULL gsa_accessions,bioproject_accession,cncb_banks_json FROM bioproject_publication)
(SELECT pmid,doi,title,pub_year,gsa_record_key,source_url,gsa_accessions,bioproject_accession,cncb_banks_json FROM gsa_publication)
(SELECT pmid,doi,title,pub_year,NULL gsa_record_key,source_url,NULL gsa_accessions,NULL bioproject_accession,cncb_banks_json FROM ${databaseCode.toLowerCase()}_publication)
(SELECT pmid,doi,paper_title title,publish_year pub_year,NULL gsa_record_key,source_url,NULL gsa_accessions,bioproject_accession,cncb_banks_json FROM genbase_publication)
p ON ((CASE WHEN r.left_identifier_type=#{identifierType} AND r.left_identifier=#{identifier} THEN r.right_identifier_type ELSE r.left_identifier_type END='PMID' AND p.pmid=CASE WHEN r.left_identifier_type=#{identifierType} AND r.left_identifier=#{identifier} THEN r.right_identifier ELSE r.left_identifier END) OR (CASE WHEN r.left_identifier_type=#{identifierType} AND r.left_identifier=#{identifier} THEN r.right_identifier_type ELSE r.left_identifier_type END='DOI' AND p.doi=CASE WHEN r.left_identifier_type=#{identifierType} AND r.left_identifier=#{identifier} THEN r.right_identifier ELSE r.left_identifier END) OR (CASE WHEN r.left_identifier_type=#{identifierType} AND r.left_identifier=#{identifier} THEN r.right_identifier_type ELSE r.left_identifier_type END='SOURCE_KEY' AND p.gsa_record_key=CASE WHEN r.left_identifier_type=#{identifierType} AND r.left_identifier=#{identifier} THEN r.right_identifier ELSE r.left_identifier END)) WHERE r.database_code=#{databaseCode} AND r.active=1 AND r.relation_type='RELATED_PUBLICATION' AND ((r.left_identifier_type=#{identifierType} AND r.left_identifier=#{identifier}) OR (r.right_identifier_type=#{identifierType} AND r.right_identifier=#{identifier})) ORDER BY r.discovery_depth,r.id LIMIT #{offset},#{size}
mapper.update: UPDATE gsa_publication SET grants_json=#{grantsJson},update_time=NOW() WHERE (#{identifierType}='PMID' AND pmid=#{identifier}) OR (#{identifierType}='DOI' AND doi=#{identifier}) OR (#{identifierType}='SOURCE_KEY' AND gsa_record_key=#{identifier})

UPDATE bioproject_publication SET grants_json=#{grantsJson},update_time=NOW() WHERE (#{identifierType}='PMID' AND pmid=#{identifier}) OR (#{identifierType}='DOI' AND doi=#{identifier}) OR (#{identifierType}='SOURCE_KEY' AND bioproject_record_key=#{identifier})
UPDATE research_relation_crawl_queue SET status='PENDING',last_error=NULL,update_time=NOW() WHERE job_id=#{jobId} AND status='FAILED'
UPDATE research_relation_crawl_queue SET status='SUCCESS',last_error=NULL,update_time=NOW() WHERE job_id=#{jobId} AND depth>0 AND status IN ('PENDING','RUNNING','FAILED')
